steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Knitting and crochet create fabric from yarn through interlocking loops — knit/purl for knitting; chain, double crochet, treble for crochet. | Key Fact: Tension/gauge determines fabric density — always make a tension square before starting a project to ensure correct sizing. | Key Fact: Weaving interlaces warp (lengthwise) and weft (crosswise) threads — tabby (plain) weave and twill weave are fundamental structures. | Key Fact: Colour work techniques (Fair Isle, intarsia) create patterns within knitted fabric through colour changes.
